title: Siege of Belgrade (1739)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Belgrade (1739)", at revision 1375791029, opens: "The Siege of Belgrade saw the recapture of Belgrade by the Ottoman Empire in 1739." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5036987, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1739 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
